notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Sources: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000012927-25-000015) and 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-25-049921, ownership as of February 24, 2025). David Calhoun ceased to be President and CEO and a director on August 8, 2024 (proxy footnote 2) and retired from the company on March 1, 2025, but he is still listed in the 2025 proxy as a named executive officer. His 261,523 'Shares Beneficially Owned' include 209,555 shares issuable on exercise of vested stock options, plus any interests in the 401(k) plan's Boeing stock fund (footnote 5); the table's 457,583 total adds 196,060 stock units that are not beneficial ownership and is not used. The proxy states every listed person owns less than 1%, so pctEconomic is null. 5% HOLDERS: Vanguard's 6.5% rests on an SEC filing reporting holdings as of December 29, 2023, before Boeing's 2024 common stock issuance, so it is stale; BlackRock and Capital Research report as of December 31, 2024. DIVIDENDS: no common dividends were paid in 2024. Mandatory convertible preferred stock was issued in 2024 ($5,657 million net, cash-flow statement), but the financing section shows no dividend payment of any kind in 2024, so dividends are recorded as 0. BUYBACKS: the quoted Item 5 sentence covers the fourth quarter; for the full year, the cash-flow statement's financing section has no share repurchase line; its $83 million 'Employee taxes on certain share-based payment arrangements' is tax withholding, not a buyback. STOCK COMP: $407 million is the cash-flow add-back; the note's 'Restricted stock units and other awards $409' million is a slightly different measure and is not used. GEOGRAPHY: the reported total ($66,517m) is after a negative reconciling line, 'Estimated potential concessions and other considerations to 737 MAX customers, net of insurance recoveries' (-$443m), which is not a region and is left out of segments; the regional rows therefore sum to $66,960m.
